name: 30-Second Sit-to-Stand
protocol: Sit on a standard chair, arms crossed over your chest. Stand fully and sit back down as many times as you can in 30 seconds.
notNested: This is not a medical device and does not diagnose anything. It reports a count and your own trend over time.

norms._status: PLACEHOLDER — DO NOT SHIP OR PUT IN THE DECK UNTIL CITED
norms._instruction: Source published age- and sex-banded reference ranges for the 30-second chair stand test and record the full citation in `source` below. Until then the app shows the raw count and the personal trend only, which need no citation and are the defensible part anyway.

phrasing.belowRange: Below the typical range for your age group — worth discussing with a physiotherapist.
phrasing.inRange: Within the typical range for your age group.
phrasing.aboveRange: Above the typical range for your age group.
phrasing.noNorms: Reference ranges are not configured. Your count and your own trend are shown.
